name: Rouge no Densetsu
source:
A long time ago, a legendary hero defeated an evil dragon. He wore a magical bracelet that protected him during the battle. Years passed, and the memories of his heroic deeds, even his name, have faded away from people's minds. But a young girl named Rouge, who trains regularly in the art of sword-fighting, still dreams about a real hero - more precisely, imagines that she will marry one. 

[Edited from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/rouge-no-densetsu-legend-of-rouge]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，一位传奇英雄击败了邪龙。战斗中，他佩戴着一只保护自己的魔法手镯。岁月流逝，他的英勇事迹乃至姓名，都逐渐从人们记忆中淡去。可是，经常刻苦练习剑术的少女露玖依然梦想遇见真正的英雄——更准确地说，她幻想着有朝一日嫁给英雄。

[根据 [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/rouge-no-densetsu-legend-of-rouge]MobyGames[/url]修改]
